changes: Corrected Fort metal-roof outline using R336 visual boundary and classified transverse sections R385/R386; independently authored two metal planes, ledge, inner parapet and coping.

Independent four-zone analytic earth cover replaces inherited sampled surface above x+y=-100; 225 held-out classified controls, RMS 0.055868m, max 0.226968m. Regular architectural tessellation, no scan vertices/faces/photo texture transferred.
29 inherited fort exterior masonry eave vertices joined to the new analytic roof profile.
38 closed contact wedges join the previously cut pavilion terrain boundary to R363 floor. All five former gap rays now hit geometry; surrounding terrain and measured floors remain unchanged.
118 independent standing-seam strips on metal roof. Spacing 0.55m is visual estimate, not surveyed.

R398 metal-deck/stone-parapet assumption is wrong. Zinneke rooftop view 2 directly shows timber boards, horizontal perimeter louvers and sloping metal fascia. INPA independently states vertical perimeter glazing. R400 hides the wrong parapet, coping and metal seams; rebuilds glazing, frames, seven horizontal louver rows, sloped fascia and timber joints. Lower/upper measured planes retained; old METAL object names only retained for traceability.
R401: removed false transverse roof-end glazing/fascia/ledge; capped remaining band ends and extended measured timber deck to its footprint.

R402: traced low tower court and built R399 classified plane. 28 held-out controls RMS .01906m, max .03755m. Inherited open-top masonry has 70 boundary edges before and after; no claim of single-mesh watertight body.
R403: true source-visible roof access opening and independent metal guard; internal staircase not modeled without visible geometry.

R405/R406: five source-positioned circular recesses, five segmental arch recesses and nine narrow recesses on east fort wall; stone collars/lintels/jambs. All 19 center rays confirm .55m modeled recess depth, not surveyed depth.

R407/R408: continuous middle tower reaches low court; three photo-proportioned court-facing blind arcades and windows. Outer two tower feet close court-side gaps while existing caps and exterior fort wall remain.

R413/R414: independent analytic tower-end earth shoulders, 26 held-out controls RMS 0.05706m, max 0.17929m. Rebuilt as one continuous closed cover to remove artificial cross-domain seam. No source faces or texture transferred.
R415: east middle moat floor continuation from R335 validated plane, four held-out controls RMS 0.01843m, max 0.02906m; local covering terrain/path faces clipped.
R416: photo-supported sloping zinc riser and separate upper timber ledge replace vertical ledge lip. Projection 0.34m is a visual estimate.

R417: visual QA detected a false transverse earth beam closing the photo-visible open roof end. Removed only the terminal corridor from cover domain; zero classified end-profile controls fall in removed corridor. New roof-eye render confirms beam absent.

R418: all three tower roofs independently rebuilt as conical architecture from classified controls. West 80 held-out controls RMS 0.07019m, max 0.13695m; centre 24 RMS 0.02356m, max 0.04641m; south 80 RMS 0.04625m, max 0.12279m. Cornices meet new eaves and inherited acorns repositioned to cap.

R419 local south-tower court facade: independent continuous body, five photo-proportioned blind-arch bays, four narrow recesses, one recessed door, jambs/sills. R418 conical roof unchanged. No source surface/photo texture copied. Refined cornice avoids clipping arch crowns.

verification.scope: Technical checks do not establish source fidelity.
verification.visualReview: Arch crowns no longer intersect cornice after final iteration. South facade remains provisional: angles, material tone, courtyard boundary and inherited acorn need source fidelity work. Not accepted for publication.

rejected: R388 whole-earth cubic field failed; not applied.
R394 whole tower-end shoulder failed; not applied.
R396 all-edge terrain blend worsened independent grade RMS .268 to .363m; not inherited by R397/R398.
R398 raised standing metal seams and R389 stone inner parapet are hidden and superseded by R400 photo-supported architectural elements.

R409-R411 east tower-end eave fits fail independent controls (RMS .34-.41m, maximum .92-.95m). None applied to R408. Do not repeat smooth single-profile fits; source shows distinct structural levels. West-only fitted candidates also not applied.
remaining: Whole museum ring incomplete; R419 local unaccepted candidate. Public model remains R418 review publication.
R419 south facade bay angles and dimensions remain photo-proportioned and need registration; source scan is torn/occluded. West tower facade, stone fidelity and acorn forms incomplete.
Fort earth shoulders and tower roofs now have independent elevation checks, but courtyard perimeter, remaining wall openings and coping/material fidelity still need source acceptance.
Photo-visible roof access opening is preserved; unseen interior staircase depth/landing remains unverified.
Pavilion retaining continuation, west terrace contacts, museum base interfaces, north/east ruin coping and lower east moat remain unresolved. R415 covers only verified middle segment.
R416 top-view dark deck lines were checked with rays: sampled positions hit actual ledge/deck levels, not duplicate faces. Do not call them proven z-fighting.
R413/R414 are superseded by R417 continuous cover with open terminal corridor. Their objects remain hidden for traceability. Do not export hidden objects.
